scope: S26 core product save/open/import/update/cancel/restart lifecycle; no requirement-wide verified promotion or inherited #43/#45/#46 closure
checks: The standard R3 sourceHash was recomputed before and after review and matched the frozen hash. The author evidence prose and redacted raw JSON agree on sourceHash, PIDs 18700/134176, save state, import counts, update checksum, and recovery time.

An independent run against the prepared Electron 33.4.11 ABI 130 runtime returned exit 0, PASS case=s26 assertions=25, and S26_FIRST_RUN_COMPLETE, S26_RESTART_RECOVERED, S26_ALL_ASSERTIONS_REACHED. It observed distinct owned PIDs 122316/39200. The author's raw sample was restored byte-identically after this run.

The scenario uses one OS-temp profile and store across two real src/main/index.js processes. It inspects each PID and full command line, invokes a gated graceful app.quit action, and waits for exact process exit before restart. Readiness and indexing convergence use RPC and SQLite events with deadlines rather than fixed success sleeps.

Public save_document asserts saved=true, indexing.state=queued, a diagnostic jobId without queued boolean, and a separate completed ledger job. Public search finds the control document. The exact eight-tool HTTP list is checked; independent MCP parity regression passed.

External A and a second lexical junction path B resolve to one canonical original and retain two aliases under one document ID. The distinct-canonical same-byte case remains duplicate_candidate under FR-DOC-035 AC-7 and passes the registrar contract test; issue #49 now states this distinction.

The Settings preload and product IPC run linked import with imported=2 and missing=1. Two contained completed files and their document IDs survive restart; a later import write failure or import cancellation is not claimed by this product sample and S25 supplies focused cancellation evidence.

A 2,782,074-byte OLD-to-NEW original update is cancelled through the Settings preload while an owner document job is active. The cancelled job is durable, desired revision 2 remains dirty, and original/store checksums match. Restart completes revision 2, retains aliases and project/category/tags, retrieves NEW, and reports no OLD hit.

The test-first record gives the exact S26 command and named exit-1 assertions for missing graceful quit, legacy cancel routing, stale keyword cache, and linked import owner routing. It separately labels fixture timeout and search-oracle corrections as non-product RED. The focused keyword refresh test records a separate exit-1 read-fault assertion before GREEN.

Independent owner-managed keyword refresh, opened registrar, and MCP parity tests passed. Unknown scenario exit 2 and S25/S23/S20/S21 plus adjacent contracts are recorded in the author evidence. Test-only private actions require both a specific environment flag and argv flag and add no public MCP tool.
limits: Historical RED executions and the broader regression matrix were assessed from the author's documented commands, assertion names, and evidence; this reviewer independently reran final S26 GREEN and three focused contracts.
